input.old_string:
## Upgrading from 2.3

No changes are needed.
input.new_string:
## Upgrading from 2.3

Clients that call /search more than 10 times a second now get 429
Too Many Requests. Back off and retry after the Retry-After header.

The per-key limits are listed in docs/rate-limits.md, with the
headers each response carries:

- X-RateLimit-Limit
- X-RateLimit-Remaining
- X-RateLimit-Reset

Keys on the partner plan keep their old limits until 1 November.
